engine: studio-video-engine config binding (seedvr2 plan hashes the whole resolved domain + machine)
environment: Episode 04, tail-restoration plan technical/seedvr2-tails-v001/episode/plan-v3 (re-planned once already after T-E21/T-E23 domain edits)
symptom: The tail plan-v3 dry-run was refused (`plan domain sha256 differs from the resolved config: 5a1c3fda… != d05abed4…`) hours before its GPU run, because root applied the T-E22 seam-blend engine port, which added a `seam_blend` block to domains/jenniejoy_cartoon_3d.json after v3 was planned.
root_cause: Root applied a staged engine change that touched a domain file without re-checking pending engine plans; plans bind the full domain/machine sha (by design), so any domain edit invalidates every unexecuted plan.
root_cause_status: measured (T-E30 builder ran the dry-run before/after its own change: identical refusal)
fix_or_workaround: Re-plan the tails as plan-v4 against the current config; domain/machine configs frozen until the tails have executed.
prevention: Before applying ANY change to domains/*.json, machine.json, recipes or episode configs: list unexecuted engine plans and run their execute dry-run after the change; if a GPU run is pending, stage the config change until after it. Longer term (T-E29 note): bind plans only to the config keys they use.
verification: T-E30 report (three byte-identical dry-run refusals); plan-v4 dry-run pending.
